gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-saira: Heavy and commanding, Impact Label spaces its letters like beads on a rod, while Saira stays clean beneath with see-through s shapes. Impact Label earns its keep big and brief.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-sarpanch: Sarpanch reads friendly and current, its lowercase e opening wide while the ascenders sit close to the x-height line. Impact Label above it hits hard, then gets out of the way.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-schibsted-gro: Schibsted Grotesk reads approachable, with generous tall bowls on its e and a. Add Impact Label's pincer-shaped c, and the pairing gets heft with a welcoming undertone.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-sen: Sen reads modern and tall, each lowercase letter traced by one flat, unvarying line that curves away before turning inward. Impact Label supplies the weight above, so the page gets punch first and quiet after.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-sintony: Impact Label's most distinctive habit is its letters standing alone like beads on a rod, each c opening like pincers. Impact Label is built to hit hard, and Sintony is built for a smooth, chunky read.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-sofia-sans: Impact Label's c opens like a pair of pincers, and every letter stands apart like a bead on a rod. Sofia Sans answers with flat-weight, rounded, tall lowercase glyphs that are made for reading rather than shouting.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-sofia-sans-se: Impact Label spaces each letter alone like a bead on a rod, with a high x-height guide and pincer-shaped c's. And Sofia Sans Semi Condensed does the quieter job, with lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals and a constant stroke.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-sono: Approachable and professional, Sono sets tall lowercase with generous spacing. Impact Label brings the heavy, commanding voice up top, while Sono's ajar a lets the text breathe below.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-stack-sans-no: Stack Sans Notch reads open and clean, with big-bodied lowercase. Giving Impact Label a large size would make the most of that commanding weight, and leave the text to its uniform strokes.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-stack-sans-te: Stack Sans Text reads like marker lines, with big lowercase and no hairlines in its a. Impact Label earns its keep when it runs big and short, hitting hard before the sans-serif takes over.
